title: NoeVera: Can Knowledge Guide Experiments and Experiments Refine Knowledge?
abstract: arXiv:2611.29255v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: With the growing demand for large language model (LLM) services, optimizing LLM serving systems is becoming increasingly complex, and the bottleneck is no longer predicting how a given configuration will perform. The harder problem is deciding what to investigate: which mechanisms matter for a workload, which configurations are worth testing, and what evidence a decision still needs. In this work, we present NoeVera, an agentic Second Brain that goes beyond just one-shot retrieval by turning papers, code, benchmarks, and experimental results into a persistent, provenance-preserving knowledge base with three planes: source evidence, reusable synthesis, and agent memory. Decision-aware retrieval assembles compact evidence packs, role-specific agents reason over them and invoke a simulator (Vidur or GAUSS) whenever quantitative support is needed, and every finding is written back as a scoped evidence record, so knowledge guides experiments

translated_title: NoeVera：知识能否指导实验，实验又能否反哺知识？
translated_abstract: 随着对大语言模型（LLM）服务需求的日益增长，优化LLM服务系统正变得愈发复杂，瓶颈已不再是预测给定配置的性能表现。更困难的问题在于决定要研究什么：对于某个工作负载，哪些机制至关重要、哪些配置值得测试、以及一项决策还需要什么证据。在本工作中，我们提出了NoeVera，一个超越单次检索的智能体式“第二大脑”，它将论文、代码、基准测试和实验结果转化为一个持久化且保留来源可追溯性的知识库，该知识库包含三个层面：源证据、可复用的综合知识以及智能体记忆。决策感知检索会组装紧凑的证据包，各角色的专属智能体对这些证据进行推理，并在需要定量支持时调用模拟器（Vidur或GAUSS），而每项发现都会作为带有作用域的证据记录写回知识库，从而使知识能够指导实验。
tldr: NoeVera是一个智能体式“第二大脑”，它将论文、代码、基准与实验结果整合为保留来源、持久化的三层知识库，通过决策感知检索、角色化智能体推理与模拟器调用，构建“知识指导实验、实验反哺知识”的闭环，以优化LLM服务系统的科研决策。
en_tdlr: NoeVera is an agentic Second Brain that turns papers, code, benchmarks, and experimental results into a persistent, provenance-preserving three-plane knowledge base, enabling a closed loop where knowledge guides experiments and experiments refine knowledge for LLM serving system optimization.
